title: createProject
responsibility: Creates app, library or game project files from admitted names and template inputs, preserving ordered writes and overwrite protection.

inputs.name: createProject.input
inputs.description: Project kind and name with optional parent directory, game dimension and force; omitted parent creates the named directory relative to the current directory, and omitted force protects changed files.

inputs.name: renderCreateProject.result
inputs.description: Created project kind/name and actual per-file write statuses to render.

outputs.name: createProject
outputs.description: Promise of the validated project kind/name and ordered file-write results; earlier successful writes are not rolled back after a later failure.

outputs.name: renderCreateProject
outputs.description: Human-readable creation heading and per-file create/skip/overwrite lines.

errors.name: Error("Dimension must be 2d or 3d.")
errors.description: Throws Error with this exact message when a provided dimension is neither 2d nor 3d.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid project names and refused overwrites with the existing CLI failure messages.

errors.name: Project file failure
errors.description: Template construction and filesystem errors propagate; the caller owns recovery of a partially written target.
